compute_3d_box_area: compute the volume of 3D bounding boxes given xyzxyz coordinate tensors
convert_3d_box_cxcyczwhd_to_xyzxyz: convert 3D boxes from center-size format to corner coordinate format using box_cxcyczwhd_to_xyzxyz
convert_3d_box_xyzxyz_to_cxcyczwhd: convert 3D boxes from corner coordinates to center-size format using box_xyzxyz_to_cxcyczwhd
compute_3d_box_iou: compute pairwise intersection over union between two sets of 3D bounding boxes using box_iou
compute_generalized_3d_box_iou: compute generalized IoU between two sets of 3D bounding boxes using generalized_box_iou
